name: country_name comment: 国家名称（英文） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: country_name_local comment: 本地语言名称 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: continent comment: 所属大洲 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: is_multi_timezone comment: 是否多时区国家 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: dial_code comment: 电话区号（如+1/+33） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: default_currency_code comment: 法定货币 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: default_language_code comment: 主要语言 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 状态 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: currency comment: 货币 note: ISO 4217 作主键，decimal_places 影响价格计算（JPY=0, USD=2, KWD=3） columns: - name: currency_code comment: 货币代码（如USD/EUR/GBP） constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: currency_name comment: 货币名称（英文） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: currency_symbol comment: 符号（如$/€/£） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: decimal_places comment: 小数位数 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 状态 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: language comment: 语言 note: ISO 639-1 作主键，rtl 影响前端布局方向（阿拉伯语/希伯来语） columns: - name: language_code comment: 语言代码（如en/fr/de） constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: language_name comment: 语言名称（英文） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: language_name_local comment: 本地语言名称 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: rtl comment: 是否从右到左 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 状态 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: timezone comment: 时区 note: IANA 时区数据库标识，系统自动同步维护，不支持手动新增 columns: - name: timezone_id comment: 时区ID（IANA标识，如America/New_York） constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: timezone_name comment: 时区名称（如Eastern Time） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: utc_offset comment: UTC偏移（如UTC-5） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: has_dst comment: 是否有夏令时 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 状态 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: country_timezone comment: 国家-时区关联 note: 一个国家可对应多个时区（如US有4个），单时区国家也保留1条记录 columns: - name: id comment: 关联ID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: country_code comment: 国家代码 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: timezone_id comment: 时区ID constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: market comment: Market 市场 note: Market = 商业运营单元，一个 Market 可包含多个国家 columns: - name: market_id comment: Market ID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: market_code comment: Market 代码（如US/EU/APAC） constraint: UNIQUE type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: market_name comment: Market 名称 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: base_timezone comment: 基准时区 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: business_day_cutoff comment: 业务日切时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: launch_date comment: 上线日期 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 状态（planning/active/suspended） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: market_country comment: Market-国家关联 note: 一个 Market 包含多个国家，支持国家级独立域名配置 columns: - name: id comment: 关联ID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: market_id comment: Market ID constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: country_code comment: 国家代码 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: is_primary comment: 是否主要国家 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: priority comment: 优先级 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: use_independent_domain comment: 是否使用独立域名 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: independent_domain comment: 独立域名（如looply.fr） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: local_timezone comment: 本地时区（可选覆盖） constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: local_day_cutoff comment: 本地日切时间（可选覆盖） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: custom_config comment: 例外配置（JSON） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: launch_date comment: 该国上线日期 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 状态（active/suspended） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: market_language comment: Market-语言关联 note: 一个 Market 支持多种语言，is_default 标记默认语言 columns: - name: id comment: 关联ID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: market_id comment: Market ID constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: language_code comment: 语言代码 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: is_default comment: 是否默认语言 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: priority comment: 优先级 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 状态 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: market_currency comment: Market-货币关联 note: 一个 Market 支持多种货币，is_default 标记默认货币 columns: - name: id comment: 关联ID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: market_id comment: Market ID constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: currency_code comment: 货币代码 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: is_default comment: 是否默认货币 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: symbol_position comment: 符号位置（before/after） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: priority comment: 优先级 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 状态 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: translation comment: 翻译内容 note: 混合策略：核心内容集中翻译，长尾内容分布式翻译 columns: - name: translation_id comment: 翻译ID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: resource_type comment: 资源类型（product/category/cms） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: resource_id comment: 资源ID constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: field_name comment: 字段名 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: language_code comment: 目标语言 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: translated_value comment: 翻译内容 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: translation_source comment: 翻译来源（manual/ai/vendor） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: source_version comment: 源内容版本号 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: source_hash comment: 源内容哈希 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 状态（draft/pending_review/approved/outdated） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: reviewed_by comment: 审核人 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: reviewed_at comment: 审核时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: relations: - from: country to: currency type: N:1 label: 法定货币 color: '#4A90D9' penwidth: 1.4 - from: country to: language type: N:1 label: 主要语言 color: '#4A90D9' penwidth: 1.4 - from: country_timezone to: country type: N:1 label: 国家 color: '#4A90D9' penwidth: 1.4 - from: country_timezone to: timezone type: N:1 label: 时区 color: '#4A90D9' penwidth: 1.4 - from: market to: timezone type: N:1 label: 基准时区 color: '#E8833A' penwidth: 1.4 - from: market_country to: market type: N:1 label: 归属市场 color: '#E8833A' penwidth: 1.4 - from: market_country to: country type: N:1 label: 国家 color: '#E8833A' - from: market_country to: timezone type: N:1 label: 本地时区 color: '#90A4AE' style: dashed - from: market_language to: market type: N:1 label: 市场 color: '#E8833A' - from: market_language to: language type: N:1 label: 语言 color: '#E8833A' - from: market_currency to: market type: N:1 label: 市场 color: '#E8833A' - from: market_currency to: currency type: N:1 label: 货币 color: '#E8833A' - from: translation to: language type: N:1 label: 目标语言 color: '#7B1FA2' penwidth: 1.4 design_rules: market_definition: Market = 商业运营单元（销售区域），一个Market可包含多个国家（如EU Market包含FR/DE/IT/ES），也可只含一个国家（如US Market） market_country_unique: market_country 表的 (market_id, country_id) 组合唯一，确保一个国家只能归属一个Market country_simplicity: country 表只保留基础属性（名称、大洲、时区、电话区号、默认货币/语言），税费/合规/地址等业务配置由独立模块管理 translation_strategy: 混合策略：核心内容（商品/类目）集中翻译，长尾内容（UGC）分布式翻译。source_hash 检测源内容变化，status=outdated 触发重译 channel_granularity: Channel 归属 Market，按策略划分（如 EU Market 的 Online/Retail 渠道），不按国家拆分 cross_border_default: Market 内跨境购买是默认能力（cross_border_enabled=true），无需额外配置 domain_strategy: 域名策略：默认使用 market_country.use_independent_domain=true 启用独立域名（如 looply.fr），否则跟随 Market 统一域名。支持渐进式策略：初期全用统一域名，业务成熟后按国家切换独立域名 exception_config: market_country.custom_config 存储国家级例外配置（JSON），覆盖 Market 默认策略 reference_data_pk: 基础参考数据（country/currency/language）使用国际标准代码作主键（ISO 3166-1/ISO 4217/ISO 639-1），语义清晰，跨模块引用时可读性强 timezone_design: 时区独立为 timezone 实体（IANA 标识作主键），通过 country_timezone 关联表支持一国多时区（如US有4个时区）。Market 有基准时区（base_timezone），market_country 可选覆盖本地时区（local_timezone） business_day_cutoff: Market 级别设置业务日切时间（business_day_cutoff），影响报表统计和库存快照。market_country 可选覆盖本地日切时间（local_day_cutoff） audit_fields: 所有实体统一通过数据库层自动维护审计字段（created_by/created_at/updated_by/updated_at），不在 ER 图中逐表重复列出
